Calculate maximum precipitation over a rolling window (terra version)

Source: R/precipitation_terra.R
calculate_maximum_precipitation_over_window_terra.Rd

Calculate maximum precipitation over a rolling window (terra version)

Usage

calculate_maximum_precipitation_over_window_terra(
  r,
  var_name = "tp",
  window_size = 5L,
  mask_path = NULL,
  threshold = 0.8
)

Arguments

r

A terra::SpatRaster, hourly (or sub-daily) resolution precipitation, with terra::time() set. Non masque : le masquage se fait ici, une fois les donnees reduites a la resolution journaliere (voir note ci-dessous).

var_name

Variable name in dataset. Default "tp", inherited from ERA5 (variable name in the NetCDF).

window_size

Rolling window in DAYS. Default 5.

mask_path

Path to the mask NetCDF file, or NULL (no masking).

threshold

Numeric threshold for the mask. Default 0.8.

Value

Same structure as calculate_maximum_precipitation_over_window().
